faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Malirian says, "Our scouts tell tale of an unusually warm location in the swamp , and I want you to verify their reports and find the source of the heat." "I will give you a specially calibrated device. If it reaches temperatures above a certain point, it will change color permanently from blue to red. Take the device to the location, and search for the source of the heat." "When the device changes color, you will be able to see what the heat source is. Return to me with what you learn." [ edit ] Objectives Take the device to the hot area of the swamp, and search for the source of the heat. The thermometer will change color from blue to red when the source is found. Return with the red heat sensing device to Malirian Syrell at the Recondite Threshold . Red Heat Sensing Device (1) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ?
